resources.string: a node in your pocket — the same ledger, the same judge
Acts only inside apps you have green-lit in Covenant Node, only on a job you place from this phone, and writes every action to the app\'s actions.log. No gestures. Nothing remote.

Samsung: Settings › Apps › Covenant Node › Battery › Unrestricted, and Battery › Background usage limits › Never sleeping apps. Add this phone\'s IP:5001 to the PC node\'s --peers, or use mobile/usb_link.py over a cable. Share any text to this app from another app to judge it.
